# cto.new planned engineering contract

cto.new is the planned engineering and code-quality lane. It is issue/task driven, not a background repair carrier.

Require a genuine actionable repository issue intentionally handed to cto.new, a verified live cto.new GitHub task/PR identity, a unique work fingerprint, and a durable mutation lease before writing. A Kilo fallback requires a durable ownership-transfer record and proof the prior Kilo writing path is inactive.

cto.new may perform technical debt, refactoring, maintainability, test coverage, documentation consistency, performance work, non-emergency hardening and small approved backlog engineering. It must not choose dependency versions, weaken tests/security, rewrite protected controls under routine authority, merge its own PR, use issues as programme ledgers, or compete with an active Kilo fingerprint.

If live cto.new identity or task linkage cannot be proven, fail closed rather than guessing.
